# Lines are in the order they arrived.
# What Firefox 157.0 (Playwright's build, macOS arm64, headless) sent to open a WebTransport
# session, decrypted per stream as the lab's QUIC server (aioquic 1.7.2 at the QUIC layer alone,
# crates/kiln-http/lab/wt-capture) received it, 2026-11-04, the server sending the door's SETTINGS.
# Firefox spoke draft-02: SETTINGS_ENABLE_WEBTRANSPORT 0x2b603742 = 1, and no later dialect. It
# needs from the server before it sends CONNECT: 0x2b603742 = 1 and H3_DATAGRAM = 1 (either id).
# Then the page echoed a bidi stream, a uni stream and a datagram, and closed (code 7, "bye").
browser firefox 157.0
draft draft-02
# The control stream: SETTINGS (QPACK table 65,536, 20 blocked streams, ENABLE_WEBTRANSPORT,
# H3_DATAGRAM both ids, ENABLE_CONNECT_PROTOCOL 1, GREASE).
stream 2 00041501800100000714ab6037420180ffd2770133010801f5457d2634f29d1d031e64a5
# Its QPACK encoder and decoder streams, empty past their types.
stream 6 02
stream 10 03
# The CONNECT (HEADERS, 303 bytes).
stream 0 
stream 4 404100
stream 4 68656c6c6f2d62696469 fin
stream 14 40540068656c6c6f2d756e69 fin
datagram 0068656c6c6f2d646772616d
# Last, on the CONNECT stream, WT_CLOSE_SESSION (code 7, "bye") in a DATA frame, and its FIN.
stream 0 000a68430700000007627965 fin
